gphotos.note: Empty = the pipeline auto-resolves the latest Photos release from APKMirror. APKMirror ships true universal APKs (all ABIs in one file), so the previous 7.21 pin is no longer required for 64-bit-only devices. If APKMirror is unreachable the pipeline falls back to APKPure automatically. To force a specific version, set GPHOTOS_VERSION in the environment (accepts 3-segment `7.76.0` or 4-segment `7.76.0.913939682`). To force the APKPure path entirely, set APK_SOURCE=apkpure — in that case, pin a 7.21.x universal version here to avoid APKPure's 32-bit-only modern splits.
